title: Salt Orange Juice Nicotine Salt E-Liquid
description: With this delicious nic salt e-liquid, SALT have nailed the bright, sunny sweetness of freshly squeezed oranges but added subtly complex notes of citrus zest to give the juice even more character and all-day appeal. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts with a super-smooth throat hit.
